name: structural-format
body: A text/config/data format the structural scanner claims and for which it emits structure: Markdown (`md`), shell (`sh`), YAML (`yaml`), JSON (`json`), TOML (`toml`), XML (`xml`), Dockerfile (`dockerfile`), Makefile (`makefile`), and the INI family (`.ini`/`.editorconfig`/`.gitconfig`/`.env`/`.properties`, id `ini`). Each carries its own `lang_switch` id and emits its own structure (see `requirements.requirement.structural-format-structure`). Markdown carries the `md` id, which holds its FQNs stable.
